findings.problem: Control/card/dialog radii and core measures were repeated across final overrides.

findings.problem: A later duplicate contract reset comfortable 41px fields to38px.

findings.problem: Hidden switch checkboxes inherited viewport-sized input widths and generated horizontal overflow on forms.
findings.correction: Confined the native input to1px inside its label, preserving label click, keyboard focus and visible focus ring.

findings.problem: Prefixed and action fields retained39/40px legacy surfaces while plain controls used38px.
findings.correction: A single border/radius/height belongs to the compound wrapper; inner controls fill it without duplicate borders.

findings.problem: Fiscal toolbar actions extended beyond clipped cards on narrow screens.
findings.correction: Tool groups wrap within available width and every individual action consumes the shared corner radius.

findings.problem: The application confirmation retained7px corners and a separate border/header/footer/button skin.

findings.problem: Quick-registration dialogs and cash documents outside app-root missed shared appearance; PDV loaded shared controls before its local overrides.

findings.problem: Module-specific label and input typography overrode shared component weights and line height.
